system.notes:
Centuries ago, Saint Sofia sacrificed her divine spark and living form to bind the mountain-sized demon, Tchernabog, into a permanent slumber. Now, a grim order of nuns called the Sisters of Saint Sofia carry on her selfless duty. A middle-aged woman in a well worn nun’s habit. Stoic and fearless.

AC 15 (plate mail), HP 19, ATK 1 blessed flail +4 (1d10 + bind) and 1 spell +3, MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +1, W +3, Ch +1, AL L, LV 4

Bind. Chaotic creature DC 12 CON or paralyzed 1 round.

Exorcise (WIS Spell). DC 12. Near. End a possession by a chaotic entity.

Seal (WIS Spell). DC 13. Close, one chaotic creature. 5 rounds. DISADV on attacks and spellcasting checks.

Scourge (WIS Spell). DC 12. Near, one chaotic creature. 1d10 damage.

Art by Yuri Perkowski-Domingos, 2023
